name: Sign an Ed25519 JWT
description: Sign JWT claims with a secret-backed Ed25519 seed using Convex's EdDSA format. Optional name stores the token as a secret without returning it. This signs caller-supplied claims; it does not grant venue authority or issue UCAN capabilities.

seed.description: Secret reference to a 32-byte hexadecimal Ed25519 private seed. Never pass raw key material.

claims.description: JWT claims as a map with string keys, serialized as JSON. Dates exp/nbf/iat are finite Unix seconds (fractions allowed); aud is a string or string array. No claims, timestamps, expiry or identity are added automatically.

kid.description: Optional JOSE key identifier. Defaults to Convex's public multikey. An identifier does not establish trust.

name.description: Optional destination secret name. Returns secret instead of token; use this to avoid placing a bearer token into Job output or model history.

overwrite.description: Permit replacing the named destination secret.

token.description: Compact signed JWT AString. Returned only when name is omitted.

secret.description: Stored token reference. Returned only when name is supplied.

accountKey.description: Native 32-byte Ed25519 AccountKey; JSON renders as 0x-prefixed hexadecimal.

did.description: Ed25519 did:key for the signing public key.
